mintAuthority.headline: Two native minters remain active; a multisig-controlled timelock can change permissions, while original-minter enforcement and net backing remain unverified.
mintAuthority.summary: XGLD inherits XAUt issuer risk and adds two active BNB native minters. A fresh creation-to-pin census resolves the timelock's role holders, proposer/executor and canceller Safe rosters, and five completed operations with no pending scheduled operation. The original minter's implementation and downstream authority remain unresolved, so these governance observations do not establish unavoidable delay or constrained whole-token issuance.

controls.evidence: The October 9 authenticated exact-source recovery identified XGLDTimelockController inheriting OpenZeppelin TimelockController with scheduled arbitrary CALL execution and self-call-only delay updates. Fresh BSC block 127773112 (2026-10-15T10:47:08Z) preserves its 6550-byte runtime SHA256 701d3d33d486deadd2a5f7a151c2afa55b63d848dd94e05f02231710bca8d9db and token owner binding; getMinDelay() is 172800 seconds. Complete role logs from block 104714727 through this pin, confirmed by hasRole, identify only the controller itself as DEFAULT_ADMIN, 0x939657ed1e743bb825528563a3a102ed254f150f as PROPOSER and EXECUTOR, and 0xd35bc3127fad1252c195e7d9003cdb77b3bfa5f6 as CANCELLER. The proposer/executor reports Safe 1.4.1, threshold 3 of owners [0x2010161b0ecf277908beac2ff80538cda9b4090b, 0x4334c72283c03215706ff4a5a0604c2ea82cb1ae, 0x01444f55dd8d6b5ac61e0676b7c9476e52f069c6, 0xb17ec02641cbb05932041853ffec86a7191e91cc, 0x276dbda1cccbd41e83ef37a4ce9ef0961c8c9f2b]. The canceller reports Safe 1.4.1, threshold 4 of owners [0x2010161b0ecf277908beac2ff80538cda9b4090b, 0x01444f55dd8d6b5ac61e0676b7c9476e52f069c6, 0xb17ec02641cbb05932041853ffec86a7191e91cc, 0x89289931348c050c7030fce5e798c5cfbe725e14, 0xcf52952eab895abc2576df732a5a71b128734c8d, 0x62a0abb7fa5498f2fbaaca7d0bc52f8836204e8b]. Both module lists terminate empty at the sentinel, both guard slots are zero, and both fallback handlers are 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99. Complete scheduled/executed/cancelled/delay-change logs contain five operation IDs and nine scheduled/executed calls; every ID returns getTimestamp=1, with no pending scheduled operation at this pin. This closes the observed role/signing/queue census, not signer independence, fallback-code safety, original-minter authority or whole-token unavoidable delay. Fresh source retrieval for the controller was unavailable; historical source evidence is retained rather than redated.
